reviews.title: Quiet, Bright, and Built to Last
reviews.comment: The Thermalright TL-C12C-S X3 fan pack is a fantastic value for anyone looking to upgrade airflow and add clean ARGB lighting to their build. I installed all three fans in my case and couldn’t be happier with the performance. Keeps temps stable on both CPU and GPU during gaming and multitasking Syncs easily smooth and vibrant effects. Feels durable and well-made with quality cables and connectors Installation was quick and hassle-free. If you want a high-performance ARGB fan kit that runs quietly and looks clean
reviews.author: dj

reviews.title: Quiet, Efficient Fans
reviews.comment: Very quiet fans, and they are very good at pushing mass amounts of air in or out of your case. The RGBs are synced and work well. after some configuration in SignalRGB. Overall a great set of budget fans, and they come with a good set of not too bright LEDs.
reviews.author: Mark Friedman

reviews.title: Great unit!
reviews.comment: I don't know about "silent" but they are very quiet. Colors are great, too, and it works fine with the aRGB controller on my motherboard. Been running for ~a year and no issues.
reviews.author: JS

reviews.title: Standard issue cheap case fans.
reviews.comment:
Normal budget case fans.
Quiet at normal RPM
Slightly louder when gaming.
B tier RGB.
These can be controlled by any generic RGB/Fan software, I personally use FanControl & OpenRGB.
